versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion IS machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py's version-parity check fails the run if it drifts from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's version (proven by --prove-drift). repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, hand-maintained markers; nothing checks them automatically (pageSpecVersion is additionally a const in the schema, so a PageSpec must carry 1.0.0).

approvalFlags.assetLicensingNote: REQUIRED. The source (thrivelearning.com) is a real, live company. The source project's public/assets/ holds 56 reference images copied by the user from their saved page: real customer logos, product screenshots, a real named person's photo, review/award badges, AI-vendor logos. None is in this repo; every such role is pinned to must-not-reuse / must-not-fabricate. A human must confirm licensing for anything shipped.
approvalFlags.copyNote: All copy is the clone's original placeholder copy (Nimbus / Nova). Original-site text is banned (ORIGINAL_COPY_AND_MARKS_FORBIDDEN).
approvalFlags.demoFormNote: The footer demo form is a static placeholder with no endpoint (original: HubSpot iframe). It must stay that way (DEMO_FORM_STAYS_STATIC).
approvalFlags.publishNote: This design-repo is not to be published and the repository is not to be made public.

scope.note: SINGLE-ROUTE, SINGLE-TEMPLATE. The source app has no router; nothing else exists to model.

marketing.engine: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind CSS v3 + GSAP 3.15 (ScrollTrigger, SplitText)

countsNote: Every number in counts is RECOMPUTED FROM DISK by extraction/verify_all.py's manifest-counts check (and README.md's table by readme-counts); a mismatch fails the run. Proven by --prove-drift.
entryPointsNote: Every path is INSIDE design-repo/ and verified to exist by verify_all.py's self-contained check. External build-time evidence (src/, CLONE_SPEC.md, ia.json, the pixel-audit dumps) is cited in extraction/measured-values.json instead, which degrades to warnings when absent.
snapshotNote: A design-repo is a snapshot. Re-run verify_all.py after any source change: the ledger re-greps motion values and the responsive check re-greps Tailwind classes against current source.
